MATH 134.title: Accelerated [Honors] Calculus
MATH 134.description: First course in UW's accelerated honors calculus and linear algebra sequence.

MATH 135.title: Accelerated [Honors] Calculus
MATH 135.description: Second course in UW's accelerated honors calculus and linear algebra sequence.

MATH 136.title: Accelerated [Honors] Calculus
MATH 136.description: Third course in UW's accelerated honors calculus and linear algebra sequence. The sequence covers material from MATH 124-126, 207, and 208.

AMATH 351.title: Introduction to Differential Equations and Applications

AMATH 352.title: Applied Linear Algebra and Numerical Analysis

STAT 390.title: Statistical Methods in Engineering and Science

CHEM 142.title: General Chemistry
CHEM 142.otherPrerequisites: CHEM 110 with the required grade, the General Chemistry Placement Exam, or AP Chemistry placement can provide entry. Check the current catalog.

CHEM 143.title: Accelerated General Chemistry I
CHEM 143.description: First half of UW's accelerated two-quarter general chemistry sequence.
CHEM 143.otherPrerequisites: CHEM 110 with the required grade, the General Chemistry Placement Exam, or AP Chemistry placement can provide entry. Check the current catalog.

CHEM 153.title: Accelerated General Chemistry II
CHEM 153.description: Second half of UW's accelerated two-quarter general chemistry sequence.

CHEM 145.title: Honors General Chemistry
CHEM 145.description: First course in UW's honors general chemistry sequence, covering CHEM 142 topics with greater mathematical rigor.
CHEM 145.otherPrerequisites: Entry can be based on MATH 124 or MATH 134 (which may be concurrent), the Honors General Chemistry placement exam, AP Chemistry, or IB Higher Level Chemistry. Check the current score thresholds.

CHEM 155.title: Honors General Chemistry
CHEM 155.description: Second course in UW's honors general chemistry sequence, overlapping CHEM 152.

CHEM 165.title: Honors General Chemistry
CHEM 165.description: Third course in UW's honors general chemistry sequence, overlapping CHEM 162. It is shown for sequence completeness but is not required for the BSME chemistry minimum.

PHYS 141.title: Honors Mechanics
PHYS 141.description: Honors version of calculus-based mechanics, covering PHYS 121 material in greater depth.
PHYS 141.otherPrerequisites: AP Calculus scores can also provide entry; high-school physics is recommended. Check the current grade and score thresholds.

PHYS 142.title: Honors Electromagnetism
PHYS 142.description: Honors version of calculus-based electromagnetism, covering PHYS 122 material in greater depth.

PHYS 143.title: Honors Waves, Light and Heat
PHYS 143.description: Honors version of waves, optics, and thermodynamics, covering PHYS 123 material in greater depth.

ME 123.title: Introduction to Visualization and Computer-Aided Design
